goal: 清晰阐述己方立场,并有力回应对方辩友的反驳,赢得评委认可

n1.speaker: 辩论主席 (主持人)
n1.line: This house believes that university education should prioritise employability over pure academic knowledge. Affirmative, you have the floor.
n1.lineCn: 本辩题:大学教育应优先培养学生的就业能力,而非纯学术知识。正方,请开始陈述。

grammar.name: Prioritise A over B
grammar.note: 观点论述框架的核心结构:prioritise A over B 表示“优先 A 而非 B”,立场鲜明。

options.text: Thank you. First and foremost, we argue that employability is what students themselves expect: the vast majority enrol with career goals in mind.
options.textCn: 谢谢。首先,我们主张就业能力正是学生自己的期待:绝大多数人入学时就带着职业目标。
options.feedback: 用 First and foremost 开门见山,再以事实佐证,结构清晰有力。

options.text: We think employability is better than academic knowledge, and we will tell you why.
options.textCn: 我们认为就业能力比学术知识好,我们会告诉你们为什么。
options.feedback: think、better than 过于随意,论证框架缺失,对方很容易抓住把柄。

options.text: Our side believes universities should teach jobs first, and forget about theory entirely.
options.textCn: 我方认为大学应该先教工作技能,完全忘掉理论。
options.feedback: “完全忘掉理论”的极端化表述自曝弱点,给对方留下攻击口实。

n2.speaker: 反方一辩 (对手)
n2.line: We reject the premise that employability and academic knowledge stand in opposition. Surely a solid theoretical foundation ultimately serves careers better.
n2.lineCn: 我们反对把就业能力与学术知识对立起来的预设。扎实的理论功底最终岂不更有利于职业发展?

grammar.name: We reject the premise that...
grammar.note: 辩论反驳第一招:先攻击对方论点的前提 (premise),比逐句反驳更高效。

options.text: We would challenge that in two ways. Although theory is valuable, the evidence shows graduates struggle most with practical skills, not with concepts.
options.textCn: 我们从两方面反驳。虽然理论有价值,但证据表明毕业生最吃力的是实践技能,而非概念。
options.feedback: although 让步加 evidence 支撑,再以 not... but 收束,反驳严密。

options.text: No, you are wrong, theory is not better, we are right.
options.textCn: 不对,你们错了,理论并不更好,我们才对。
options.feedback: 只有立场没有论据,且打断式否定违反辩论礼貌,评委难以认同。

options.text: We never said theory is useless; we said universities should weigh practical training more heavily in the curriculum.
options.textCn: 我们从没说理论无用;我们说的是大学应在课程中更重视实践训练。
options.feedback: 澄清误解加重申立场,既不退让也不歪曲,是驳论的好范例。

n3.speaker: 辩论主席 (主持人)
n3.line: Affirmative, I would remind you to structure your argument: state a position, give reasons, and support each reason with evidence.
n3.lineCn: 正方,提醒你们结构化论证:表明立场、给出理由、并用证据支撑每条理由。

grammar.name: Structure your argument
grammar.note: 观点论述框架三要素:position (立场) + reasons (理由) + evidence (证据),缺一不可。

options.text: Thank you. To be precise, our position is that curricula should embed work placements, because surveys show employers rank hands-on experience above grades.
options.textCn: 谢谢。准确地说,我方立场是课程应嵌入实习环节,因为调查显示雇主把实践经验排在成绩之上。
options.feedback: position + because + 调查数据,框架完整,成功扳回一城。

options.text: Okay so basically, more jobs, less theory, that is all I am saying.
options.textCn: 好吧,基本上就是多点工作技能,少点理论,我就想说这个。
options.feedback: basically 加口号式陈述,仍未组织起论证,对方攻势将压垮你。

options.text: We maintain that practical training should take precedence, and studies from several universities support this view.
options.textCn: 我方坚持实践训练应占优先地位,多所大学的研究支持这一观点。
options.feedback: maintain 加 take precedence 表达立场,再给出研究支持,基本合格。

n4.speaker: 反方二辩 (对手)
n4.line: Your studies may favour practical skills, but we wonder whether those skills become obsolete within a decade. What protects a worker trained only for today's jobs?
n4.lineCn: 你们的研究或许偏向实践技能,但我们怀疑这些技能十年内就会过时。只接受当下职业训练的人,靠什么保护自己?

grammar.name: We wonder whether...
grammar.note: 委婉质疑句式:we wonder whether 代替直接攻击,既能保住风度又暗含杀机。

options.text: An astute point, but it actually strengthens our case: because skills evolve, universities must teach adaptability rather than fixed content, and adaptability is itself an employability skill.
options.textCn: 敏锐的观点,但它反而加强了我们的立场:正因为技能在演变,大学必须教适应力而非固定内容,而适应力本身就是就业能力。
options.feedback: 借力打力 (strengthen our case),把对方论据反转成己方论据,是高阶技巧。

options.text: You are wrong, workers will be fine, so let us move on to our next point.
options.textCn: 你们错了,工人会没事的,我们进入下一个论点吧。
options.feedback: 强行跳过对方质疑,问题没有解决,评委与对手都不会放过。

options.text: We would reply that lifelong learning is the answer: a curriculum that trains people to learn keeps them employable as industries shift.
options.textCn: 我方回应:终身学习才是答案。训练人们学会学习的课程,能让其在行业变迁中保持就业力。
options.feedback: 以 lifelong learning 承接对方问题,回应有深度,展现了辩手的成熟。

n5.speaker: 反方一辩 (对手)
n5.line: I would invite the affirmative side to respond to our challenge properly rather than dismissing it: how do you reconcile theory and employability?
n5.lineCn: 请正方正面回应我方挑战,而非一挥手否定:你们如何协调理论与就业能力的关系?

grammar.name: Reconcile A and B
grammar.note: reconcile A and B 表示“调和、使……相容”,是辩论中讨论矛盾概念的首选动词。

options.text: We reconcile them by sequencing: students first acquire core theory, then apply it in placements, so the two are complementary, not competing.
options.textCn: 我们通过排序来协调:学生先掌握核心理论,再在实习中应用,二者互补而非竞争。
options.feedback: 先给出方法 (sequencing) 再解释结果,把对立转化为互补,回应堪称完美。

options.text: I do not know how to reconcile them, but our side still wins.
options.textCn: 我不知道怎么协调,但我方依然占理。
options.feedback: 承认无解还坚持取胜,这在辩论中是严重失分。

options.text: In our view the two are not mutually exclusive; theory informs practice, and practice in turn deepens theoretical understanding.
options.textCn: 我方认为二者并非互斥:理论指导实践,实践又反过来加深理论理解。
options.feedback: 用 not mutually exclusive 加 in turn 的递进,思路清晰,站稳立场。

n6.speaker: 评委 (评审老师)
n6.line: The affirmative side speaks of adaptability. Could you give a concrete example of how a university could build it into the curriculum?
n6.lineCn: 正方提到了适应力。你们能否举出具体例子,说明大学如何把它融入课程?

grammar.name: A concrete example
grammar.note: 评委常要求 concrete example (具体例证):论点只有配实例才真正落地。

options.text: Certainly. A project-based module where students tackle real industry problems each term trains them to transfer skills across domains, which no lecture can achieve.
options.textCn: 当然。项目式课程让学生每学期解决真实行业问题,训练他们跨领域迁移技能,这是讲座式课堂无法做到的。
options.feedback: 具体课程设计加 no lecture can achieve 的对比收束,实例扎实有画面感。

options.text: For example, universities can teach students to adapt, which is a good skill to have.
options.textCn: 比如,大学可以教学生适应,这是项好技能。
options.feedback: 用“教学生适应”解释“教适应”,循环论证,等于没举例子。

options.text: Take internship modules linked with company projects: students rotate through different roles, and that rotation is precisely what builds versatility.
options.textCn: 以校企联动的实习模块为例:学生轮换不同岗位,这种轮换正是塑造多面能力的方式。
options.feedback: 从实习模块到角色轮换,层层具体,versatility 收尾点题。

n7.speaker: 反方三辩 (对手)
n7.line: Time is short, so let us press the core issue: even if practical training is valuable, is it the university's duty, or the employer's?
n7.lineCn: 时间有限,我们直击核心:即便实践训练有价值,它是大学的职责,还是雇主的职责?

grammar.name: Press the core issue
grammar.note: 辩论收尾常用策略:press (紧逼) 核心议题,迫使对方在关键点上表态。

options.text: We would argue the responsibility is shared, but universities must lead, since they control the transition point where students first enter the workforce.
options.textCn: 我们认为责任共担,但大学必须主导,因为大学掌握着学生初次进入职场的过渡节点。
options.feedback: shared but must lead 的定位既务实又坚定,用过渡节点论证职责归属。

options.text: It is the employer's job, clearly, so universities should not worry about it.
options.textCn: 显然是雇主的活,大学不用操心。
options.feedback: 一句话推卸掉全部责任,与己方“大学应优先就业能力”的主旨自相矛盾。

options.text: We maintain that universities bear the primary duty, on the grounds that only they reach every future employee before the career begins.
options.textCn: 我方坚持大学承担主要职责,理由在于:只有大学能在职业生涯开始前触达每一位未来员工。
options.feedback: on the grounds that 给出严密的归因,立场与论证高度一致。

n8.speaker: 辩论主席 (主持人)
n8.line: The floor is yours for a final summary. In no more than a minute, why should this house vote for your side?
n8.lineCn: 最后陈词时间交给你们。在一分钟内,为什么本场应投给你们?

grammar.name: A final summary
grammar.note: 辩论框架的收束环节:final summary 要求概括论点并重申立场,绝不能引入新论点。

options.text: To summarise, we do not dismiss theory; we demand balance with practice. Because graduates deserve skills for today and minds for tomorrow, we ask for your vote.
options.textCn: 总结而言,我们不否定理论;我们要求与实践平衡。因为毕业生既需要今日之技能,也需要明日之头脑,请投我们一票。
options.feedback: 先澄清误解,再以 because 收束价值主张,结尾金句有力,评委深受打动。

options.text: Yeah, so vote for us, we are right, thank you.
options.textCn: 对,投我们吧,我们是对的,谢谢。
options.feedback: 没有总结没有升华,以“我们是对的”结尾,说服力完全落空。

options.text: In short, employability is not the enemy of knowledge but its completion; universities that pair the two prepare students for a changing world.
options.textCn: 简言之,就业能力不是知识的敌人,而是知识的完成。将两者结合的大学,才为学生面对变化的世界做好了准备。
options.feedback: 排比式收束 (not the enemy but its completion) 层次高,立场完整收口。

success.speaker: 辩论主席 (主持人)
success.line: The judges have deliberated. By a majority decision, the motion is carried by the affirmative. Congratulations!
success.lineCn: 评委已评议完毕。以多数票,动议由正方通过。祝贺你们!

grammar.name: The motion is carried
grammar.note: 固定表达:the motion is carried 意为“动议获得通过”,是辩论赛宣布结果的规范用语。

fail1.speaker: 辩论主席 (主持人)
fail1.line: The judges regret to inform you that the affirmative side fails to persuade on the core issues raised this round.
fail1.lineCn: 评委遗憾地告知:正方未能就本轮提出的核心问题作出有说服力的回应。

grammar.name: Fail to persuade
grammar.note: fail to + 动词表示“未能……”,是正式场合宣布失利结果的稳妥说法。

fail2.speaker: 反方二辩 (对手)
fail2.line: We thank the affirmative for the debate. Given the unanswered objections, we believe the verdict speaks for itself.
fail2.lineCn: 感谢正方的参与。鉴于多项反对意见未获回应,我们认为结果不言自明。

grammar.name: Speaks for itself
grammar.note: 固定短语 speak for itself 表示“不言自明”,辩论收尾中用于暗示胜负已分。
